title: Trump 'open' to meeting with Venezuelan interim leader a week after capture
summary: On January 11, Donald Trump said his administration was working well with Venezuelan interim leader Delcy Rodriguez and that he would be open to meeting with her, in a small respite since the capture of Maduro. But for many Venezuelans FRANCE 24's James Andre spoke to on the border with Colombia, the expected change away from Maduro's regime has yet to come…
contentText: On January 11, Donald Trump said his administration was working well with Venezuelan interim leader Delcy Rodriguez and that he would be open to meeting with her, in a small respite since the capture of Maduro. But for many Venezuelans FRANCE 24's James Andre spoke to on the border with Colombia, the expected change away from Maduro's regime has yet to come. He tells us more from his time at the border with Colombia.
